## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] `npm --prefix ui run typecheck`, `npm --prefix ui run lint` and `npm --prefix ui test` pass
- [ ] New user-facing text goes through `ui/src/i18n.ts` (English, plus Norwegian if you can)
- [ ] New actions work with both mouse and keyboard
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes
